title: Chill Salt E-Liquid – Green Lime 30ml
description:
Description
Zesty and irresistible lemon lime soda freshly squeezed to perfection, leaving you refreshed.
30ml Bottle
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Chill is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
